# Featured Papers

#### [Multicellular rosette formation guides epithelial tissue assembly in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cell organoids](<https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2512284123>)
*Marion K. Raich, Fridtjof Brauns, Tamara Müller, Maximilian Reichert, Andreas R. Bausch* <br>
Fluctuations in acto-myosin contractions combined with geometrical nuclear confinement dictate the regular spacing of rosettes, which subsequently form functional lumens through inner-cell apoptosis.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Dispersion Polymerization in an Elastomeric Solvent](<https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.macromol.6c00969>)
*Senthilkumar Duraivel, Reagan J. Dreiling, Tyler E. Ball, Jay Fu, Ethan E. O’Banion, Harsha Koganti, Brett P. Fors, Eric R. Dufresne* <br>
Elastically mediated polymerization-induced phase separation within deformable elastomeric networks yields uniform microparticles whose size, shape, and morphology can be precisely controlled by monomer loading, matrix elasticity, and applied mechanical strain.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [The value of a prophage-borne defense system in phage–phage competition](<https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014739>)
*Yigal Meir, Ned S. Wingreen* <br>
Non-transitive, rock–paper–scissors interactions between competing variants allow viral defense mechanisms to remain evolutionarily stable and drive persistent population oscillations despite associated growth costs.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Cell-body curvature reduces stall frequency to enhance Vibrio cholerae swimming and chemotaxis through hydrogels](<https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-026-10883-9>)
*Marwan Malik, Ziyang Chen, Andrew G. T. Pyo, Zemer Gitai, Ned S. Wingreen, Marianne Grognot* <br>
Hydrogel-induced stalls reorient bacteria down chemical gradients, but a natural cell curvature matching the optimal geometry for mesh navigation prevents these interruptions to significantly boost chemotactic drift.
:::
